reason: The problem is real and the timing stings with my VC on my back, but I'm a do-it-yourself guy and €9,500 to have someone rewrite a pitch I think I can learn from a book and a few blogs is a hard no for me right now. I'd rather audit my own demo first and see how far I get.
objection: No hay garantia de resultado. I pay €9,500 up front and if enterprise buyers still ghost me after the demo, I'm out the money with nothing to show my board.
would_change_my_mind: A result-based deal or clear proof it worked, concrete case studies with named seed/Series A startups and the conversion numbers before and after.
